{{Quote|Skywalker, the enemy warship has attacked our convoy of medical transports near Ryndellia.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]], to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />}}
'''Ryndellia''' was a celestial object in the [[Ryndellia system/Legends|Ryndellia system]],<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" /> in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]'s [[Ryndellian sector/Legends|Ryndellian sector]], close to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was also close to the [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]]<ref name="DB">{{DB|location|kaliidashoals|Kaliida Shoals Med Center}}</ref> and the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] ''[[Malevolence/Legends|Malevolence]]'' [[Battle of the Ryndellia system/Legends|destroyed]] a Republic medical convoy near Ryndellia.<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ryndellia was first mentioned in "[[Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence'']],"<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" /> the third episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which aired on [[October 10]], [[2008]].<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence air date">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode003.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Shadow of ''Malevolence''}}</ref>
